defects.title: feat(cohorts): turn realtime on and off per cohort

issues.claim: Existing behavioral cohorts saved before condition_type existed remain NULL with no backfill; once realtime evaluation trusts the column/readiness stamp on deploy, those existing cohorts evaluate dynamically and match nobody until manually resaved.

defects.title: feat(code-review): move review and auto-approval names to code_review

issues.claim: posthog/migrations/1440_rename_code_review_scopes.py runs in the deploy hook and rewrites millions of rows on large OAuth tables (posthog_oauthapplication / oauth2_provider_accesstoken) with GIN indexes on scope, blocking production deploys.

defects.title: feat(clickhouse): drop the legacy metrics1 and metrics2 tables from the logs cluster

issues.claim: posthog/clickhouse/migrations/0381_drop_legacy_metrics_on_logs.py drops metrics2_backfill_series before dropping its dependent dictionary metrics2_backfill_series_dict, failing migrate_clickhouse in production and blocking deploys.

defects.title: refactor(tags): stop writing the legacy tagged item keys

issues.claim: posthog/migrations/1376_taggeditem_untrack_legacy_keys.py drops foreign keys to 13 parent tables in a single transaction, acquiring AccessExclusiveLock on posthog_taggeditem then parent tables in opposite order from live readers and deadlocking production deploys.

defects.title: feat(replay): add a recording-api route that encrypts blocks for a new session

issues.claim: nodejs/src/session-replay/recording-api/auth.ts requires a scoped JWT on the new encrypt route with no legacy-secret fallback, so every caller fails with 401 in production until the JWT signing key is deployed.

defects.title: feat(workflows): support templated From overrides in email steps

issues.claim: Making the email step's From override load-bearing in resolveFromEmailAddress breaks existing production steps that already hold a stored placeholder sender address off the integration's verified domain, failing every send after deploy (INC-990).

defects.title: feat(taxonomy): track 30-day query usage for properties

issues.claim: posthog/management/commands/backfill_insights_query_metadata.py locks each batch of insight rows during query-metadata extraction, blocking live user insight saves while the backfill runs in production.

defects.title: feat(logs): add a command that moves stock alert destinations off hog functions

issues.claim: products/logs/backend/destination_conversion.py retires legacy HogFunction destinations during cutover without draining or fencing already-queued legacy alert events, dropping in-flight notifications.

defects.title: feat(batch-exports): update query, filters and custom schema for `events_json`

issues.claim: products/batch_exports/backend/custom_events_schema.py switches custom events schemas to recompile against events_json, breaking already-saved schemas created by users with property restrictions whose stored hogql_query was previously dropped.

defects.title: feat(workflows): encrypt secret function inputs on hog flow actions

issues.claim: Moving secret HogFlow action inputs to an encrypted column without backfilling or migrating existing rows causes an ordinary re-save of a pre-existing legacy flow to drop its stored secret (INC-987).

defects.title: feat: Don't Label Users as Quota Limited for N Days After They Exceed Their Quota

issues.claim: ee/billing/quota_limiting.py moves already over-quota tokens into a new grace-period Redis set on the first post-deploy run while capture still reads the old limiter set, lifting quota enforcement on existing over-quota orgs at deploy time (INC-154).

defects.title: feat(cohorts): day and night schedules for cohorts

issues.claim: posthog/tasks/scheduled.py registers day/night cohort beat entries by passing a five-field cron string to crontab() as the minute argument instead of get_crontab, raising during Celery beat boot and leaving all later periodic tasks unregistered on deploy (INC-242).

SessionAuthentication enforces 2FA on orgs with enforce_2fa enabled without exempting SSO-authenticated sessions, which never set the 2FA verified flag, locking existing SSO users into 403s on deploy (INC-496).

posthog/clickhouse/migrations/0049_add_inserted_at_projection.py adds a SELECT * projection and materializes it for the live events partition during deploy-time migration, causing heavy production cluster load (INC-120).

defects.title: feat: new endpoints required for listing workflows and getting agents

issues.claim: products/tasks/backend/migrations/0006_remove_workflowstage_agent_alter_task_workflow_and_more.py edits an already-applied Django migration instead of creating a new migration, so production databases never apply the schema change (INC-542).

defects.title: feat(tasks): skip CI follow-up reruns when PR is closed or unchanged

issues.claim: products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/workflow.py schedules a new Temporal activity ahead of an existing one without workflow.patched(), causing replay nondeterminism for already in-flight workflows on deploy (INC-815).

defects.title: feat: add project secret api key API & authenticator

issues.claim: posthog/auth.py adds a phs_ guard in the shared personal-API-key lookup that raises instead of returning None, breaking existing callers authenticating with legacy secret tokens on local-evaluation endpoints (INC-702).

clean.why_safe: Populates hard_bounced_at on suppression writers while #124638 keeps legacy reason-text fallback for older rows.

clean.title: feat(tasks): mark tasks done behind a per-profile flag
clean.why_safe: Flag-gated task-done rollout (off/shadow/enforce, default off) with safe rollback and Temporal patching.

clean.title: feat(oauth): return supports_step_up from token introspection
clean.why_safe: Additive supports_step_up field on OAuth token introspection; ID-JAG tokens default safely to false.

clean.title: feat: backfill legacy secret tokens into PSAK table
clean.why_safe: Properly sequenced PSAK backfill migration that explicitly waited for #111078 compatibility fixes to land first.

clean.title: feat(messaging): add provider import run model
clean.why_safe: Additive new ProviderImportRun model and initial table migration; no pre-existing rows affected.

clean.title: feat(warehouse_sources): deprecate profound api version v1
clean.why_safe: Small bounded repin migration for deprecated Profound API v1 sources.

clean.title: chore(data-modeling): delete the in-workflow trino shadow comparison
clean.why_safe: Clean removal of already-retired in-workflow Trino shadow comparison in Temporal workflow.

clean.title: feat(slack_app): remind people once when their slack onboarding stalls
clean.why_safe: New Temporal onboarding reminder workflow/activity; does not mutate existing in-flight workflow histories.

clean.title: feat(weekly-digest): add a command to resend a digest to chosen organizations
clean.why_safe: Explicitly scoped operator management command to resend weekly digest for chosen org IDs.

clean.title: feat(signals): rank the error tracking backfill by user impact
clean.why_safe: Bounded ranking update for error tracking backfill without altering persisted schema or lock scope.
